description: Editorial evaluation rubric (AES-P3.2 / SUE-450). Two classes with different authority: integrity dimensions are hard gates decided by evidence; editorial dimensions are judgements that require an observation and never produce an authoritative single score.

integrity.authority: hard gate — a fail blocks finalization regardless of any editorial rating

editorial.authority: advisory — a human editorial judgment remains final for style and insight

no_aggregate_score: There is deliberately no total. A single number would hide the one thing this rubric exists to reveal: that a piece can improve on every editorial dimension while failing on integrity.

dimensions.name: citation-integrity
dimensions.fails_when: A citation does not resolve, repeats to inflate the evidence base, points at a working document, or does not support the claim beside it.

dimensions.name: polish-preservation
dimensions.fails_when: A protected span changed across a polish pass — a number, unit, date, citation marker, quotation, URL, or technical term added, removed, or altered.

dimensions.name: claim-support
dimensions.fails_when: A material claim is unsupported, or an interpretation is presented as a verified fact.

dimensions.name: publication-state
dimensions.fails_when: An article reaches published without recorded human approval, or any Skill claims publication, approval, or finalization authority.

dimensions.name: provenance-lineage
dimensions.fails_when: An artifact cannot identify its article version that produced it, carries a claim the article never verified, or asserts a staleness level its hashes contradict.

dimensions.name: presentation-portability
dimensions.fails_when: A semantic block's plain-Markdown fallback loses information, or Writer output carries HTML, CSS, a colour, or a renderer component name.
dimensions.note: Four of the E-12 checks are mechanically decidable and are enforced here instead: renderer leaks, colour-carried meaning, lossless fallback, and callout density. The rest need a reader.

dimensions.name: thesis-clarity
dimensions.asks: Is there a falsifiable position, stated early enough for this content type, that the piece actually argues?
dimensions.evidence: Quote the sentence carrying the thesis, or record that none exists.

dimensions.name: synthesis
dimensions.asks: Does the piece connect sources in a way none of them does alone, or does it walk them in order?
dimensions.evidence: Name the paragraph doing the connective work, or cite the citation sequence showing a walk.

dimensions.name: evidence-density
dimensions.asks: Do the paragraphs carry numbers, dates, mechanisms, or other evidence at the level this content type warrants without confusing density with compression?
dimensions.evidence: The measured fraction against the profile floor, plus any paragraph whose explanation adds understanding without another fact.

dimensions.name: original-reasoning
dimensions.asks: Is there a connective step the sources do not supply — a decomposition, a mechanism, a consequence?
dimensions.evidence: Point to it, or record its absence.

dimensions.name: fact-interpretation-separation
dimensions.asks: Can a reader tell, sentence by sentence, what is sourced, what is our reading, and what is hypothesis?
dimensions.evidence: Quote a blended sentence, or confirm the registers stay marked.

dimensions.name: flow-density
dimensions.asks: Does every paragraph change what the reader knows or understands, while allowing enough space for a difficult inference to become legible?
dimensions.evidence: Quote the emptiest paragraph or the most over-compressed passage.

dimensions.name: headline-fidelity
dimensions.asks: Does the title carry the claim the piece makes?

dimensions.name: overclaiming
dimensions.asks: Is any certainty asserted that the evidence does not carry?

dimensions.name: ai-scaffolding
dimensions.asks: Is there prompt echo, repetition, placeholder text, or formulaic sectioning?

dimensions.name: content-type-fit
dimensions.asks: Does it meet its profile's evidence burden and read in that profile's register rather than importing one register into every content type?
dimensions.evidence: The profile check result plus one register observation.

dimensions.name: voice-fit
dimensions.asks: Does it preserve the shared voice core — precision, restraint, factual honesty, and terminology discipline — without mechanically imitating observed signature moves?
dimensions.evidence: Quote a sentence that fits or a repeated rhetorical move that makes the house style visible instead of the argument.

dimensions.name: presentation-fit
dimensions.asks: Does each semantic block's role match the actual information function, and does the structure clarify rather than fragment?
dimensions.evidence: Name a block whose role does not match its content, or confirm the roles fit; record the block-to-prose ratio.
checks: the semantic role matches the information function, not the desired look
scanability actually improves — a reader finds the load-bearing claim faster
callout density does not fragment the reading flow
a data_table represents a real two-dimensional relationship, not layout
qualification and uncertainty are not weakened by being moved into a block
no raw HTML, CSS, or renderer component name leaks from Writer output

dimensions.name: language-native-prose
dimensions.asks: Does the prose read as composed in its publication language, or can the reader see another language's discourse order, connective scaffolding, or terminology choices underneath it?
dimensions.evidence: For Korean, quote a translationese sentence, repeated meta-connective, English noun accumulation, or domain term a Korean practitioner would not normally use that way; otherwise record the native-language observation appropriate to the piece.
dimensions.note: This is a prose-quality judgement, not an AI-origin detector. Correct grammar is not sufficient: a sentence may be grammatical and still preserve a translated discourse skeleton.

regression_rule.statement: A run is a regression if any integrity dimension moves from pass to fail, regardless of how many editorial dimensions improved.
regression_rule.rationale: This is the rule the method exists for. A piece that reads better and states a wrong number is worse, and any method that reports it as an improvement is measuring the wrong thing.

human_authority.statement: A human editorial judgment is recorded separately and is never replaced by a rating in this rubric.
human_authority.rationale: Model ratings inform; they do not accept. Style and insight quality stay with the editor.

presentation_note: A visually richer output that becomes less clear, less portable, less accessible, or factually more ambiguous is a regression. Visual richness is never itself a positive score. Portability is decidable and sits in the integrity class (I-6); whether structure actually clarifies is judgement and sits in the editorial class (E-12).
